title: Hyouga Yui — Nine Hells Frozen
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Ice classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Own Ice strikes landing harder (Permafrost Heart): heavier on every cast (a +1 commit, then +1 Damage with a +2% exposure rider: Nine Hell's Spear and Glacial Shatter: Purgatory 45 → 47, Cerulean Storm: Avalanche 40 → 42 EP, Spear's circle and Cocytus's target 35 → 37%), or harder inside the window (+8% on both self buffs, Avalanche and Glacier's Will 35 → 43%)
emphasis.secondary: Control of the exchange (Cocytus Vigil): +8% exposure on Cocytus's target and Spear's circle (35 → 43%), or +10% guard on Cocytus (35 → 45%) and Glacier's Will's tiles (30 → 40%)
emphasis.tertiary: A real edge-or-amplifier choice: on the same three nodes the R1 Avalanche + Glacier's Will / R2 Spear + Cocytus / R3 Purgatory opener gives the steady edge 307.0 strike power against the Amplifier's 306.5; the edge stays 1 EP ahead on every strike and leaves 37% exposures for the party, the Amplifier takes ×1.043 on every other own hit inside its window. Every capstone leads with one tag; only the edge carries a rider
emphasis.rationale: Permafrost Heart answers "How do I make my Ice strikes land harder: heavier on every cast, or harder inside my window?": Weight of the Avalanche commits +1 Damage and Buried in the Avalanche pays +1 more on every strike with +2% Increase Damage Taken on Spear's circle and Cocytus's target; Deepening Frost and The Glacier Advances raise both 2-round self buffs. Cocytus Vigil answers "How do I control the exchange: open them to every blow, or shut us off from theirs?": Nine Hells Opened deepens both marks to 43%, Locked in Cocytus guards the caster and the allies on Glacier's Will's tiles. Each percentage tag already owns one Hidden Art, so the steady edge's Hidden Art commits flat Damage instead of twinning one. Flat Damage stops at the same +2 the director-approved anchors use (47 / 47 / 42 EP): +5 would turn both 45s into 50 Nukes and the 40 into a 45. Wound, shield and move are unsupported. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Permafrost Heart
nodes.flavor: The cold settles in the chest first. Everything after it strikes harder.
nodes.coverage_note: Self damage buffs 35 → 38%: Avalanche's (Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits) and Glacier's Will's (every non-pierce hit), live for the 2 rounds after each cast.

nodes.name: Weight of the Avalanche
nodes.flavor: Snow gathers on the slope long before it falls. Every strike carries a little more of it.
nodes.coverage_note: Damage +1 EP on the three Ice circle strikes (Spear and Purgatory 45 → 46, Avalanche 40 → 41) on every enemy in each circle: the steady edge's commit, live on every cast, outside any window.

nodes.name: Buried in the Avalanche
nodes.flavor: No one digs out of the ninth winter.
nodes.coverage_note: Steady-edge route total +2 Damage: Spear and Purgatory 45 → 47, Avalanche 40 → 42 EP on every enemy in each circle, on every cast; no tier crossed. Rider: exposure 35 → 37% (×1.030) on Spear's circle and Cocytus's target for the two rounds after the cast.

nodes.name: Deepening Frost
nodes.flavor: Frost does not stop at the skin. It keeps going down.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self damage buffs 40% with Permafrost Heart; Avalanche's lands with its 60 AP strike, Glacier's Will's with its 40 AP ground cast.

nodes.name: The Glacier Advances
nodes.flavor: A glacier moves a hand's width a day and nothing in its path survives the year.
nodes.coverage_note: Amplifier route total +8%: both self buffs 35 → 43%, ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 (×1.82 unbuffed) on own hits both cover in the two rounds after the casts.

nodes.name: Cocytus Vigil
nodes.flavor: Keep watch over the frozen lake. What is held in it cannot strike back.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure 35 → 37% on Cocytus's target and Nine Hell's Spear's circle; guard 35 → 37% on Cocytus (self) and 30 → 32% on Glacier's Will's tiles.

nodes.name: Cracks in the Ice
nodes.flavor: Every surface has a seam. The cold finds it and widens it.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure's setup: Spear's circle and Cocytus's target 35 → 39% with Cocytus Vigil (×1.060), which Nine Hells Opened deepens to 43%.

nodes.name: Nine Hells Opened
nodes.flavor: The spear does not close the wound it opens. It opens eight more.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure route total +8%, 35 → 43% for the two rounds after the cast: Spear's circle on every non-pierce hit from any attacker, allies' included; Cocytus's target on element-less hits and hits of the caster's highest offence stat. ×1.122 on a target holding both, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 and Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075.

nodes.name: Rime Mantle
nodes.flavor: Rime thickens on the shoulders until blades skate off it.
nodes.coverage_note: Guard 40% with Cocytus Vigil on Cocytus (self) and 35% on Glacier's Will's circle (caster and allies on the tiles).

nodes.name: Locked in Cocytus
nodes.flavor: The lake freezes around both of you. Only one of you was ready for it.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress route total +10%: Cocytus 35 → 45% on the caster, Glacier's Will's tiles 30 → 40% for the caster and allies on them; ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 on non-pierce hits while both are live, ×0.725 against the unmodified rows (Deathless Vitality ×0.747).

examples.name: Buried in the Avalanche
examples.rationale: Weight of the Avalanche commits +1 Damage and Buried in the Avalanche pays +1 more on all three Ice circle strikes, on every cast and outside any window (Spear and Purgatory 45 → 47, Avalanche 40 → 42 EP), with exposure 37% on Spear's circle and Cocytus's target, so each Spear deepens the mark the next strike lands on. Deepening Frost is the solo fourth (self buffs 40%): in the R1 Avalanche + Glacier's Will / R2 Spear + Cocytus / R3 Purgatory opener the strikes total 42 + 92.1 + 172.9 = 307.0, against 306.5 for the Amplifier on the same three nodes, and every strike is 1 EP ahead of it. Cocytus Vigil (exposures 39%, guard 37% / 32%; 304.4) is the party fourth.

examples.name: The Glacier Advances
examples.rationale: Both self buffs 35 → 43%: cast together (Avalanche 60 AP + Glacier's Will 40 AP) they compound ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 (×1.82 unbuffed) on own hits both cover for the next two rounds, strikes, weapons and normal jutsu alike; Avalanche's own hit takes neither. In the same opener the strikes total 40 + 92.0 + 172.7 = 304.7. Cocytus Vigil is the fourth (exposure 37%, guard 37% / 32%); Weight of the Avalanche (+1 Damage, 306.5) is the solo alternative, ×(1.43 / 1.40)² ≈ ×1.043 over the steady edge on every other own hit in the window but 1 EP behind on every strike and without the edge's 37% exposures.

examples.name: Nine Hells Opened
examples.rationale: Both exposures 35 → 43% for the two rounds after the cast: Spear marks every enemy in its circle against every non-pierce hit, Cocytus marks one target against element-less hits and hits of the caster's highest offence stat; on a target holding both, covered hits from the caster and allies compound ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04, ×1.122 over the unmodified marks (Blood-Enchanted Eyes ×1.115). The caster's own opener is 40 + 85.7 + 175.2 = 300.9, so the route pays in a party. Permafrost Heart is the fourth (self buffs 38%, ×1.045 × 1.122 ≈ ×1.172, the tree's top offensive package, under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.234); Rime Mantle (guard 40% / 35%) is the defensive alternative.

examples.name: Locked in Cocytus
examples.rationale: Guard at the route maximum: Cocytus 45% on the caster, Glacier's Will's tiles 40% for the caster and allies on them, ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 on non-pierce hits while both are live (×0.46 unbuffed; ×0.725 relative, against Deathless Vitality's ×0.747). Cracks in the Ice is the fourth: +4% IDT (both exposures 39%, ×1.060 on marked targets) beside that guard, against Exposure + Rime Mantle's 43% exposures beside ×0.39; Permafrost Heart (self buffs 38%, exposure 37%) is the alternative.

design_notes: Structure kept (edges 01→02→03, 01→04→05, 06→07→08, 06→09→10; 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 4 Advanced Arts). Routes: steady edge +2 Damage (Weight of the Avalanche +1, Buried in the Avalanche +1 with a +2% Increase Damage Taken rider); Amplifier +8% Increase Damage Given (+3% + 2% + 3%); Exposure +8% Increase Damage Taken (+2% + 2% + 4%); Fortress +10% Decrease Damage Taken (+2% + 3% + 5%). Every capstone pays more than its Hidden Art. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, IDG +8%, IDT +8%, DDT +10%.

Roster pass: The Glacier Advances +5% → +3% Increase Damage Given and Nine Hells Opened +5% → +4% (Cracks in the Ice +3% → +2%) Increase Damage Taken hold both two-row compounding routes at the roster's +8% (×1.43² ≈ ×2.04, ×1.122 over unbuffed) instead of +10% (×2.10). Weight of the Avalanche drops its +3% Increase Damage Taken setup: it twinned Cracks in the Ice on the same two rows, and the capstone-less 01+02+06+07 would have read +7% IDT, 1% under Nine Hells Opened.

Why the steady edge's Hidden Art is a +1 Damage commit: the kit's only tags are Damage, IDG, IDT and DDT, and each percentage tag already owns a Hidden Art on the same two rows (Deepening Frost, Cracks in the Ice, Rime Mantle), so any percentage setup twins one of them; an IDG setup would also take the Amplifier past +8% with its sibling as the fourth. Why the payoff is +1 Damage with a +2% Increase Damage Taken rider: route +2 holds the strikes at the same +2 the director-approved anchors use (47 / 47 / 42) and an off-kit 50 EP Ice row at 52. Alone, a +1 payoff bought less than a Hidden Art, because the Amplifier can buy the commit as its fourth: a rider-less Edge + Cocytus Vigil (299.5) trailed the capstone-less 01+02+04+06 (300.4). The rider gives the payoff a second job instead of more flat Damage: Spear lands heavier and deepens its own circle's mark for the strike that follows. An IDG rider would make Edge + Deepening Frost (+2 Damage, +7% IDG) a copy of Amplifier + Weight of the Avalanche (+1 Damage, +8% IDG); a DDT rider would not make a strike land harder.

Opener used in this tree: R1 Avalanche + Glacier's Will, R2 Spear + Cocytus, R3 Purgatory on a target in Spear's circle; the R1 self buffs are live in R2–R3 and both marks in R3. Strike power is EP × the live percentage rows, before the passive (271.5 unbuffed). Full builds: Edge + Deepening Frost 307.0, Amplifier + Weight of the Avalanche 306.5, Amplifier + Cocytus Vigil 304.7, Edge + Cocytus Vigil 304.4, Exposure + Permafrost Heart 300.9 for the caster, with allies' hits on the marked target ×1.122 (×1.060 after Edge + Cocytus Vigil). Not simulated.

Damage tiers: the strikes are 45 / 45 / 40 EP radius-1 area casts. The steady-edge route's +2 gives 47 / 47 / 42 and crosses no tier; +5 would turn both 45s into 50 Nukes and the 40 into a 45. Other builds borrow at most the +1 commit (46 / 46 / 41).

Fortress keeps +10% on two compounding guard rows (×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 with both live, ×0.725 against the unmodified rows: stronger than Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality ×0.747, level with Red Pestilence ×0.725), above the roster's +8% two-row default (×0.777), for three kit reasons: Deathless Vitality holds +10% Decrease Damage Taken on two self rows with +5% Decrease Damage Given on top; Glacier's Will's guard is positional, live only on its radius-1 tiles; and guard raises no output.

Fourth purchases: the steady edge takes Deepening Frost or Cocytus Vigil; Amplifier, Weight of the Avalanche or Cocytus Vigil; Exposure, Permafrost Heart or Rime Mantle; Fortress, Cracks in the Ice or Permafrost Heart. No fourth adds a step of the capstone's primary tag. Edge + Cocytus Vigil puts +4% IDT (exposures 39%, ×1.060, against Nine Hells Opened's ×1.122) beside +2 Damage; Fortress + Cracks in the Ice puts the same ×1.060 beside the ×0.33 guard; Exposure + Rime Mantle puts +5% DDT (×0.39) beside 43% exposures. Top offensive package (IDG × IDT, all windows live): Exposure + Permafrost Heart ×1.045 × 1.122 ≈ ×1.172, then Amplifier + Cocytus Vigil ×1.122 × 1.030 ≈ ×1.156, under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.234.

Delivery (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3b, §4b): all cooldown 7. Strikes: 60 AP, range 4, radius-1 circle, friendly fire ENEMIES. Cocytus: 40 AP single target, exposure on the target and guard on the caster. Glacier's Will: 40 AP EMPTY_GROUND; self buff SELF, guard an INHERIT FRIENDLY ground circle re-applied each round to the caster and allies on the tiles. Buff and debuff rows are live in the two rounds after the cast round, never in it.
risks: Classification: element-wide Ice scope (RUL-2026-10-03-005); sharing Ice with other bloodlines is expected. 4 of the 9 supported rows carry Ice; Glacial Descent: Cocytus and Glacier's Will carry no Ice row and qualify in-kit only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Ice coverage is unverified.

Self-buff stacking: Avalanche and Glacier's Will fit one 100 AP turn, so at 43% both compound to ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 (×1.82 unbuffed) on hits both cover, before the 25% + 0.15/level passive applies last. Glacier's Will's row also reaches basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu.

Exposure reach: Spear's exposure (no element) raises every non-pierce hit on every enemy in its circle, from any attacker; Cocytus's raises element-less hits and hits of the caster's highest offence stat. Spear and Cocytus fit one turn, so one target can carry 43% on both for two rounds, ×1.122 over the unmodified marks, allies' hits included. The edge's rider reaches the same two rows (39% with Cocytus Vigil, ×1.060).

Damage reach: the steady-edge route's +2 reaches every Ice Damage row the owner casts, so an off-kit 45 or 50 EP Ice row would read 47 or 52, the same +2 the director-approved anchors use; off-kit Ice coverage is unverified and the validator checks kit rows only.

Guard scale: Cocytus 45% and Glacier's Will 40% apply in sequence, ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 (×0.46 unbuffed) on non-pierce hits while both are live. The ground guard is positional and also covers allies on the tiles.

Ally hazard: none on supported rows (strikes and Spear's exposure are friendly fire ENEMIES; Glacier's Will's supported rows are SELF or FRIENDLY). Spear's wound and Glacier's Will's move are the kit's only hazard rows; both are unsupported.
Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. No combat simulation was performed; balance values remain director-owned.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Ice classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make my Ice strikes land harder: heavier on every cast, or harder inside my window?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I control the exchange: open them to every blow, or shut us off from theirs?

route_identities.03: steady edge: a +1 commit, then +1 raw Damage on all three Ice circle strikes on every cast (45 → 47, 40 → 42; no tier crossed), with a small exposure rider on Spear's circle and Cocytus's target
route_identities.05: sustained self-amplification: both self buffs compound on every own hit in the 2-round window
route_identities.08: team exposure: a deep mark on Spear's circle and Cocytus's target that lifts every attacker's hits
route_identities.10: fortress: pure guard for the caster under Cocytus and the party on Glacier's Will's tiles

design_review.director_review: Roster questions: DQ-B (Nine Hells Opened +8% Increase Damage Taken on two rows, Spear's circle and Cocytus's target 35 → 43%, ×1.122, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 and Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075); DQ-C (Locked in Cocytus +10% Decrease Damage Taken on two rows, Cocytus 35 → 45% and Glacier's Will's tiles 30 → 40%, ×0.725 with both live, stronger than Deathless Vitality's ×0.747 and level with Red Pestilence's ×0.725; trimming the route to +8% gives ×0.777); DQ-D (Weight of the Avalanche +1 Damage, the commit of a 1/1 steady-edge route, 45 → 46 → 47 and 40 → 41 → 42: every percentage setup twins a sibling Hidden Art).
concerns: The steady edge and the Amplifier are deliberately close and differ in kind: on the same three nodes the opener gives 307.0 against 306.5; the edge is 1 EP ahead on every strike and leaves 37% exposures for the party, the Amplifier ×1.043 on every other own hit inside its window. With Cocytus Vigil as the fourth the pair reads 304.4 against 304.7. Not simulated.

Weight of the Avalanche carries flat Damage on a Hidden Art (DQ-D): each percentage tag already owns a Hidden Art on the same two rows, so a percentage setup would twin one. The Amplifier can buy the +1 as its fourth (46 / 46 / 41); Buried in the Avalanche's exposure rider is what keeps the edge capstone worth more than that commit.

The edge's +2% Increase Damage Taken rider touches Nine Hells Opened's two rows: Edge + Cocytus Vigil reaches 39% exposures (×1.060 for the party, against the Exposure route's ×1.122), and it dominates the capstone-less 01+02+06+07 (+1 Damage, otherwise identical).

Exposure stays at +8% on two compounding team rows (×1.122, DQ-B) and Fortress at +10% on two compounding guard rows (×0.725, DQ-C); Fortress + Cracks in the Ice puts ×1.060 exposure beside the ×0.33 guard.
Five of the nine supported rows depend on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; off-kit Ice coverage is unverified.
